items.item_text: As a Pediatrician with UCLA Health, U can enjoy the close connection of community-focused patient care with the resources and reputation of one of the nation’s leading health systems. We are seeking a
board certified/eligible Pediatrician for our NEW Long Beach Pediatrics Practice.

Be a part of a robust team-based patient centered medical home model with after hours nurse triage, pharmacist support, co-located behavioral health, and comprehensive patient navigation assistance. Utilize your full breadth of clinical skills to treat a diverse patient population
Work within a highly-innovative practice environment, including Epic Systems
Enjoy an excellent salary, incentive and benefits program (including relocation benefits and CME stipends)
Grow your medical career with one of the top ranked hospitals in the entire country!

The South Bay offers a perfect blend of coastal living, outdoor adventure, and urban convenience. From the stunning oceanfront cliffs of Palos Verdes to the lively beach communities of Manhattan Beach, Redondo Beach, and Torrance, this region is known for its relaxed atmosphere and breathtaking scenery. Residents enjoy top-rated schools, excellent dining, boutique shopping, and endless outdoor activities, including surfing, hiking, and biking along The Strand. Whether you prefer the quiet elegance of Palos Verdes or the vibrant energy of the coastal cities, the South Bay provides an exceptional quality of life with easy access to Los Angeles and beyond.
